title: Multiple TileMaps under SubViewport causes crash in Compatibility Mode
body:
### Tested versions

- v4.4.1, v4.4.2 dev build, v4.5dev5
-Reproducible on another machine as well

### System information

Windows 10 - Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.official.49a5bc7b6 OpenGL API 3.3.0 NVIDIA 566.36 - Compatibility - Using Device: NVIDIA - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1070

### Issue description

In my game 2D top-down game I generate terrain in chunks, with 1 TileMap per chunk. Those TileMaps are under a SubViewport so I can render them to a CanvasLayer-> TextureRect and apply a Shader to them as a group.

Travelling across the map which moves the global game Camera as well as the SubViewports Camera for the Terrain can cause a reliably reproducible crash:

```

================================================================

Engine version: Godot Engine v4.4.2.rc.custom_build
```

### Steps to reproduce

Run the MRP, which will automatically generate terrain chunks and moves the player along the x-axis. The game crashes after a second or so.
